## Purpose 
Closes issue https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaLand.jl/issues/1876
The pmodel limit of J/Jmax as Jmax -> 0 is 1; this also fixes that limit. For Farquhar, Jmax should never be zero in vegetated areas so we should not need to worry about this in that case.
